tooling_bug_fixed.symptom: `day-trading.py rank` died with ZeroDivisionError in Candles.__init__ on DAAQ, aborting the WHOLE ranking cycle.
tooling_bug_fixed.root_cause: A day whose bars were all interpolated leaves a header-only CSV in data/rh_bars (DAAQ_2026-08-13.csv, written by Day 8's fake-gap names). pd.concat of that empty object-dtype frame with a real one silently coerces EVERY OHLCV column to object dtype. Candles guards flat bars with np.where(rng > 0, ...), but on an object array numpy evaluates both branches in Python, so high == low raises ZeroDivisionError instead of being masked.
tooling_bug_fixed.impact: Latent since the fake-gap detector started leaving empty CSVs. It crashes on exactly the illiquid gappers C37 trades - 5 of 10 candidates today carry flat 1-min bars. A crashed ranker is worse than a wrong one: it returns nothing at all.
tooling_bug_fixed.fix: Added _coerce_ohlcv() and applied it in both load_rh_bars() and _bars_from(); forces numeric dtype and drops unparseable rows. No ranking semantics changed.
tooling_bug_fixed.verified: rank returned a full 9-name ordering immediately after the fix.
